body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #2 (first US live run), company drawn at random (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.62 (naive base rate 0.40) that: Kirby FY2026 revenue grows >= 9.0% (>= ~$3,667M vs $3,364.1M). Our reasoning: 9M-2026 revenue +9.2%; Q4 needs >= $923M (+8.4% vs $851.8M). Q3 grew 12.2%; inland guided low-double-digit growth for the year (fuel pass-through lifts revenue), KDS high-single digits with a >$1.5bn power-gen backlog; the $115M barge acquisition closed 4-Nov-2026. Risk: KDS deliveries are lumpy (OEM engine timing). Naive base: share of Kirby's own last 10 fiscal years (2016-2025) with revenue growth >= 9%: 4 of 10 (2017, 2018, 2022, 2023) [XBRL]. Resolution: YES if FY2026 revenue (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax/Revenues, first reported in the FY2026 10-K) is >= 109.0% of the FY2025 comparative in the same filing. Source: SEC XBRL companyfacts (10-K FY2026). Resolve by 2027-03-31; score with Brier vs the base rate to test whether deep-dive probabilities beat naive base rates.
